## Stage-weighted implicit step: the correction runs with $w_2\Delta t$ under rk3 (`dt_corr`) {#sec-ch07-vic-stage}

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What it does.** Hands the VIC the step $w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$ of the current Runge-Kutta stage instead of the
full $\Delta t$, so that the implicit operator matches the increment the stage actually takes.
**Switch.** None; it applies when the integrator has three stages (`rk3`).
**Order.** Not changed by the weighting; the correction is a linearised backward Euler.
**Defining equation.** @eq-ch07-vic-stage.
:::

A stage of @eq-ch07-rk-stage adds $w_2\Delta t\,\mathcal L$. The VIC solves a linear system whose diagonal holds
$I/\Delta t$. Weighting the solved increment by $w_2$ afterwards is not the same as solving with $w_2\Delta t$,
because the operator is not linear in $\Delta t$. So snapy passes $\Delta t_{\mathrm{corr}} = w_2\Delta t$ into
the solve and leaves the explicit tendency at the full step.

### Derivation

With $\Delta\mathbf U = \Delta t\,\mathcal L$ the explicit increment and $J$ the operator of @eq-ch07-vic-blocks
without its $I/\Delta t$, the solve of @sec-ch07-vic-sweep returns
$\delta = (I + \Delta t_{\mathrm{corr}}J)^{-1}\Delta\mathbf U$, and the stage adds $w_2\delta$. With
$\Delta t_{\mathrm{corr}} = w_2\Delta t$,

$$
w_2\,(I + w_2\Delta t\,J)^{-1}\,\Delta t\,\mathcal L = (I + w_2\Delta t\,J)^{-1}\,w_2\Delta t\,\mathcal L ,
$$ {#eq-ch07-vic-stage}

which is one backward-Euler-linearised step of the stage's own length $w_2\Delta t$. The two sides agree to
$5\times10^{-16}$ in the check [check `src/snapy_report/ch07/vic_stage_check.py`, output `vic_stage_check.out`,
`[C1]`]. The factors per stage are 1, 1/4, 2/3 for rk3. Every other integrator keeps the full step (`[C2]`).

On a stiff decay $u' = -\lambda u$ handled entirely by the correction, rk3 damps a mode with
$z = \lambda\Delta t \to \infty$ to $1/12$ per step with the weighting and to $1/3$ without it (`[C3]`). Every
integrator keeps $|R(z)| \le 1$ on $z\in[10^{-3},10^8]$, and the decay converges at first order (`[C4]`).

In the code, the weighted step of @eq-ch07-vic-stage is `dt_corr` ([`hydro_forward.cpp:929-932`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L929-L932)).

### Numerical method

See @fig-ch07-vic-stage for the two choices compared.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch07-vic-stage

Green: the correction runs with $w_2\\Delta t$, as snapy does for rk3; vermillion dashed: with the full $\\Delta t$. Blue dotted: the exact $e^{-z}$. Grey lines mark the stiff limits $1/12$ and $1/3$."
#| fig-alt: "Two decreasing curves of amplification against z on a log axis, levelling off at 1/12 for the weighted correction and 1/3 for the full-step one, with the exact exponential below both."
#| echo: false

```

`MeshBlockImpl::advance_local` publishes the stage index `rk_stage` before each stage ([`meshblock.cpp:603`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L603)). The hydro forward pass then scales
only the step handed to the correction, by `wght2` ([`hydro_forward.cpp:929-932`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L929-L932)). If no stage was
published, a direct caller gets a one-time warning and the full step, through `TORCH_WARN_ONCE`
([`hydro_forward.cpp:933-943`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L933-L943)). The weighted step goes into `_apply_implicit_correction`
([`hydro_forward.cpp:968`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L968)). Inside the solve it sets both the $I/\Delta t$ diagonal
of @eq-ch07-vic-blocks and the right-hand side $\Delta\mathbf U/\Delta t$ of @sec-ch07-vic-sweep. The stage
combination itself is the integrator's, with `wght2` ([`pyharp integrator.cpp:101-122`](https://github.com/chengcli/pyharp/blob/4721715855e937c1e8b218e964c0655f46e56e29/src/integrator/integrator.cpp#L101-L122)).

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
Only rk3 is weighted. rk1, rk2 and rk3s4 run the correction with the full step in every stage, which is the
operator that the weighting was introduced to replace.
:::

1. **First order.** The correction is a linearised backward Euler; on the decay the rk3 step with it converges at
   first order (`[C4]`). That the same holds for the other integrators is a hypothesis; the check does not test it.
2. **Direct callers.** A caller of `HydroImpl::forward` outside the stage loop gets the full step, with a warning
   only once per process.
